points.description: States the table holds a mapping between destination stations (MAC addresses) and outgoing LAN interfaces/ports (optionally with timestamps).

Describes backward learning: table starts empty; on receiving a frame with source address Q on LAN L, the bridge adds/updates the (timestamped) entry 'Q reachable via L'; timestamps used to purge old entries.
States the table is used for selective forwarding: a frame for destination Q is sent only on the listed link L instead of being flooded (flooding only if unknown).
Gives one benefit, e.g. less unnecessary duplication/flooding, less congestion, or better bandwidth usage.
